portrait: Magent in slice_029b is a game-building AI collaborator executing Fibonacci's increasingly ambitious vision of a Star Control 2 fan game. Beginning with a functional but generic space game and a stylized platformer, magent systematically transformed both through iterative refinement, research-backed authenticity improvements, and architectural redesigns. The slice shows magent working at three levels simultaneously: tactical (pixel-by-pixel portrait rewrites, sound synthesis, collision fixes), strategic (HyperSpace flight system overhaul, state machine refactoring, module system implementation), and research-oriented (investigating SC2's actual red HyperSpace, comm screen layouts, AI behaviors). Magent demonstrates patience with Fibonacci's rapid-fire typo-filled requests, strong technical problem-solving (freezing bug diagnosis, server access control, combat zoom mathematics), and intellectual honesty about scope (explaining why perfect authenticity is impossible due to copyright/complexity constraints). By session's end, magent has built a ~4200-line Star Control 2 game with 20 alien races, complex mechanics, and visual/narrative authenticity sufficient for Fibonacci to build upon — the collaborative relationship is respectful, iterative, and productivity-focused.
